package_info.why_malicious: The provided report is a high-level ecosystem security overview and does not describe any specific malicious package or code. It summarizes common vulnerability types (remote code execution, cross-site scripting, denial of service) in the .NET ecosystem but does not attribute these to any particular package or provide code samples.

behavioral_signatures: Remote code execution via deserialization or unsafe input handling
Cross-site scripting vulnerabilities in web-facing .NET components
Denial of service through resource exhaustion or unhandled exceptions
file_indicators: No specific file indicators provided in the report
network_indicators: No specific network indicators provided in the report
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor .NET applications for patterns of unsafe deserialization, unvalidated user input, and resource exhaustion. Use static analysis tools to identify common vulnerability patterns such as remote code execution, XSS, and DoS. Regularly scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities using tools like Snyk.
